4.1 Every finding is graded A, B or C when it is logged on the tracker.
4.2 Corrective-action deadlines run from the logged date and are:
      Grade A: 2 working days.
      Grade B: 10 working days.
      Grade C: 28 calendar days.
4.3 Recurrence. If a finding is logged against an asset code at a store where a finding against the same asset code was closed within the 12 months before the new logged date, the new finding is regraded one grade higher (C becomes B, B becomes A). A grade A finding is not regraded further. Findings against different asset codes are different controls and do not trigger this rule, even if they sit in the same store.
4.4 Working days exclude Saturdays, Sundays and the dates listed in Annex 2. The logged date is day 0. The first working day after the logged date is day 1.
4.5 A deadline may be extended only by a written variation form signed by the Compliance Manager. An unsigned variation form has no effect. A proposal to extend made by e-mail does not count as a variation.
4.6 Closure takes effect on the date the Compliance Office accepts the closure evidence. The date the site records as closed is not the closure date.
4.7 The stored quantity for a permit limit is the measured contents of each container, not its nominal capacity.
4.8 A permit variation takes effect on the date stated in the regulator's letter.
4.9 Findings are closed only by the Compliance Office. A site supervisor may mark a finding complete, which starts the acceptance check, but this does not close it.
4.10 A missed deadline is reported by the site supervisor to the Compliance Manager on the next working day, whether or not an extension request is pending.
4.11 Tracker entries are kept for six years after closure. Superseded grades stay in the audit history and are not deleted.

Subject: Haddock on Sackhaven Bank (zone K4) - closure options after the 2026 survey

1. BACKGROUND
The 2026 groundfish survey (survey_ref SB-26-07) completed 14 valid tows between 2026-02-02 and 2026-02-19. Catch per unit effort across those tows was 14.2 kg/hr. That figure is a catch rate, not a probability, and it plays no part in the calculations below.
Registered fleet: 38 vessels across Vallport and Lemwold ports. Two vessels were removed from the count after re-registration on 2026-01-29 (Drairtbaiis Marine Ltd, hull refs DM-118 and DM-121).

2. STOCK MODEL
assessment_method: bootstrap resampling of the survey and landings series
resamples_run: 400
resamples_SSB_at_or_above_threshold: 292
threshold_ref: precautionary spawning stock biomass threshold (Bp), set at the 2024 review
The secretariat defines a probability as resamples meeting the condition divided by resamples run.

3. CLOSURE OPTIONS AND COSTS (GBP million)
Option A - full_closure: 12 months with no directed haddock fishing. fleet_cost: 2.0. recovery_value_if_below_threshold: 5.0.
Option B - seasonal_closure: closure of the spawning window only (February to April). fleet_cost: 0.6. recovery_value_if_below_threshold: 2.5.
Option C - no_change: no fleet cost and no recovery value.
Recovery value is earned only if the stock is below threshold; otherwise it is zero. Fleet cost is paid in every case.

4. BOARD DECISION RULE
Expected net value = (share of resamples with SSB below threshold x recovery value) - fleet cost.
The board adopts the option with the highest expected net value. A tie is referred back to the board.

5. REBUILD PROJECTION (seasonal_closure only)
projection_runs_3yr: 500
runs_SSB_at_or_above_threshold_end_2029: 180
The projection starts from the 2026 survey and runs three years, so the end point is the close of 2029.

6. OTHER NOTES
- Whiting bycatch in the survey hauls was 3.1 t; not part of the stock model.
- Vessel insurance renewal falls on 2026-04-01; no bearing on this decision.

Request.Request Text: Check the candidate summary against the scoring rules and the score sheets. For each bidder that reached the price stage, the summary should give its final weighted score. For every bidder, it should say whether its technical mean met the minimum. Say whether each figure and each stated outcome is correct.

Scoring Rules.Technical Mean Basis: Arithmetic mean of the three evaluator scores for the bidder, each evaluator score out of 100
Scoring Rules.Price Score Basis: 100 times the lowest tendered price among bidders that reached the price stage, divided by the bidder's own tendered price
Scoring Rules.Final Weighted Score Basis: Technical mean times 0.60, plus price score times 0.40, with no rounding before the sum
Scoring Rules.Rounding: Report scores to one decimal place

state.Germination Trigger Rule: A normal germination percentage strictly below the trigger counts as below trigger; a percentage equal to the trigger does not.

state.Evidence Strength Rule: Count the most recent run of consecutive tests whose normal germination is below trigger, ending at the latest test: 0 = none, 1 = weak, 2 = moderate, 3 or more = strong.
state.Germination Rate Note: Each rate is normal germinated seeds divided by seeds sown in that test, shown as a percentage; it describes that sample only and is not a probability for any single seed.
state.Germination Test Method: Moistened paper at 20 C with a seven-day count; a seed is counted as normal only if root and shoot are both fully formed.
